caseNameFull: Jacob Glos, in Error v. William L. O'Connell, County Treasurer, etc.
summary: In error to the Supréme Court of the State of Illinois.
attorneys: Submitted by the plaintiffs in error, pro se., Mr, George Gillette for the defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction, on the authority of Jacob Glos v. The City of Chicago &c., 226 U. S. 599, and authorities there cited.
